skills.title: Figma Motion (Config 2026)
skills.description: Design and reason about animation natively in Figma Motion — the timeline-based animation feature shipped in open beta at Config 2026. Covers the Motion timeline, keyframes, presets, easing, springs, animated components, motion variables, agent prompting, and Dev Mode export.

skills.title: Motion (motion.dev / motion/react)
skills.description: Author web/React animation in code with Motion (motion.dev, the motion/react package, formerly Framer Motion) — the library Figma Motion's React export targets. Controls map 1:1 to Figma Motion: springs, easing, keyframes, variants, stagger, repeat/mirror, gestures, layout, and SVG path drawing.

skills.title: Polymarket App Native Motion Kit
skills.description: Exact spring/timing/haptic constants extracted from the Polymarket mobile-app source, organized by action and screen flow — button press, price odometer, bet-placement flight, cash out, phase/screen transitions, grid morph, the damping census (ζ0.78–0.92, bounce reserved for money moments), and the enforced haptic map. Use to make static designs, motion comps, or creatives feel app-native.

skills.title: PM Motion Optimization Loop (self-learning)
skills.description: Self-learning lint → edit → verify → learn cycle for optimizing Figma Motion timelines against the production Polymarket app kit (pm-app-motion). Deterministic linter (motion-lint.mjs) scores springs/durations/tracks against the damping census and timing laws; edits via use_figma; cheap export_video verification; every run appends verified findings to LEARNINGS.md so the next run starts smarter.
